ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the attached figure there are two parallel straight lines inclined in the same direction, and they are cut by a steeper oblique straight line. Around the upper intersection are labeled ∠1, ∠2, ∠3, ∠4, among which ∠4 is located between the two parallel lines and on the left side of the transversal. Around the lower intersection are labeled ∠5, ∠6, ∠7, ∠8, among which ∠5 is also located between the two parallel lines and on the left side of the transversal. Reasoning: The problem gives m∠4 = 101. Because ∠4 and ∠5 are same-side interior angles formed by two parallel lines cut by a transversal, they are supplementary: m∠4 + m∠5 = 180. Therefore m∠5 = 180 - 101 = 79.

raw_record.question_text: In the figure, $m\angle 4 = 101$. Find the measure of $\angle 5$.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as two slanted parallel lines cut by a steeper transversal. Identify ∠4 at the upper intersection and ∠5 at the lower intersection; both lie between the two parallel lines and on the same side of the transversal. From the text, use m∠4 = 101. Apply the same-side interior angles theorem: ∠4 + ∠5 = 180°, so m∠5 = 180 - 101 = 79.
